review_scope: Independent RN1 recovery rescore, precipitation report, evidence manifest and per-hour map readback

rescore.scope_limit: I independently recomputed counts from the captured arrays and checked raw RN1 values and hashes. The 21 large WRF file hashes were relied on through the unchanged before/after pin receipt; I did not rerun the WRF remapping.

maps.hour_18_view: RN1 has broad southern/central coverage with a separate southwest patch; forecast panels show distinct northern and southern clusters. Figure labels 1-hour amounts and explicitly marks coverage unverified. The plotted land-grid cells and color bins are legible; no time/title or obvious rendering defect found.
maps.interpretation_limit: Visual difference describes the fields; it does not establish observation skill because RN1 sensor coverage/QC is not available.

remaining_limits: This is postprocessing of retained completed forecasts, not a new forecast run.
RN1 is a processed ODAM radar/AWS analysis and the hourly window uses the supplied 1-hour/mm product convention; historical wrapper fallback freshness cannot be recovered from headers alone.
A 3688-cell fixed geographic mask is not an observation coverage mask; independent sensor coverage, uncertainty and source independence remain unverified.
This review does not establish physical approval, statistically general forecast skill, or an isolated omega effect.
